items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee Danny Barker does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Louisa Hurley DuPont is made by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Louisa DuPont. That's beautiful. What was your mother's and father's name?
My father's name was August DuPont, and my mother's name is Louisa Hurley DuPont.
